name: Dorm No. 52
source:
A murderous ghost… your dream college… two handsome crushes. Will you enjoy your new life or run for your life? You decide.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
一只嗜血索命的恶鬼……你梦寐以求的大学……外加两位帅气迷人的心动对象。你究竟会尽情享受崭新的校园生活，还是落荒而逃保命要紧？一切由你决定。

[摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用[/url]]
